Tanya Dutta
Data Engineer | Bengaluru
tanya.dutta14@example.com | +91 9554451754

Data engineer focused on building reliable, scalable data pipelines and real-time streaming solutions. Experienced in designing ETL/ELT processes, optimizing Spark workloads, and implementing Kafka-based event-driven architectures to enable analytics and downstream applications. Collaborative team player thriving in Agile environments; available after a 30 days notice period.

Experience

CartNest — Mar 2026 - Present
Data Engineer, Remote
- Implemented Kafka-based ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and Python 3 to process clickstream and transaction events, achieving 99.7% delivery reliability and reducing end-to-end latency by 45%.
- Built Spark streaming jobs and batch ETL in Apache Spark and Python 3 to transform raw events into analytics-ready tables, improving downstream query performance by 60% and reducing ETL window from 6 hours to 75 minutes.
- Designed and maintained SQL data models in a cloud data warehouse on AWS, creating partitioning and indexing strategies that lowered average query cost by 35%.
- Automated deployment and monitoring using Linux scripts and CI/CD, tracked work and incidents in Jira while following Agile practices.

Capgemini — Feb 2025 - Feb 2026
Big Data Engineer, Onsite
- Developed Python 3 ETL frameworks and parametrized SQL ingestion jobs to standardize data ingestion across 12 enterprise sources, cutting manual intervention by 70%.
- Tuned complex SQL queries and data warehouses on AWS to reduce monthly processing cost by 28% while maintaining SLA for daily reports.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints, managed tasks and story tracking in Jira, and used Linux-based tooling to schedule and monitor data pipelines.
- Implemented data validation and reconciliation checks in Python 3 that caught and corrected 0.8% of upstream data anomalies before reporting.

Razorpay — Mar 2023 - Jan 2025
Data Engineer, Hybrid
- Built and maintained Apache Kafka pipelines to stream payment and reconciliation events, supporting 150K events/sec at peak and enabling near real-time analytics for fraud detection.
- Developed Apache Spark jobs for both streaming and batch processing to aggregate and enrich payment datasets, reducing daily processing time from 4 hours to 50 minutes.
- Optimized Spark jobs and resource utilization on AWS, achieving a 40% reduction in cluster cost while improving job success rate and lowering retry counts.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, tracked deliverables in Jira, and used Linux-based monitoring to ensure pipeline health and alerting.

Projects
- Real-time Order Tracker: Built a prototype using Apache Kafka and Apache Spark to stream e-commerce order states, implemented enrichment with Python 3 and persisted to SQL tables on AWS for analytics; reduced time-to-insight for order anomalies to under 2 minutes.
- ETL Automation Toolkit: Developed a Python 3 library to standardize ingestion, logging, and validation across Spark jobs; integrated with Jira for deployment tracking and reduced onboarding time for new pipelines by 50%.

Skills
Languages: Python 3, SQL
Stack: Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, AWS
Tools & Practices: Linux, Agile, Jira

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University

Notice period: 30 days
